$comment: agents-mcp config — copy to ~/.config/agents-mcp/config.json (or set AGENTS_MCP_CONFIG). Per-repo override: .agents-mcp.json in the repo root (defaults, agents, aliases, and routing merge over this). An alias = one CLI subscription: command + args + env. env values: literal, ~/path (expanded), or "env:VAR" (expanded from environment). envClear removes vars before env applies (subscription isolation). Priority: request arg > alias pin > Jev choice > defaults.

routing.$comment: Stage 2: Jev routing for agent_call{agent:"auto"}. enabled default true (needs TYPESAFE_API_KEY, else silent fallback); fallback agent used on any routing failure; candidates = registry Jev chooses from — note is the cost/capability hint shown as choice criteria, effortByComplexity maps the Jev complexity rating to effort (request arg and alias pin still outrank it).

agy.note: free, fastest, no subscription minutes; selectable Gemini model; weakest reasoning — bounded fact-finding, simple lookups, mechanical checks

codex.note: GPT-6.1 Sol on a Codex subscription (metered); strong general engineer; effort low runs read-only, medium/high may write to the workspace

claude.note: Claude Opus on a Claude subscription (metered, most expensive); strongest reasoning — subtle design, hard debugging, high-stakes review
